items.title: Does Raised 2026 Guidance Change The Bull Case For GE Stock?
items.summary: GE Aerospace reported strong third quarter 2026 results, with adjusted earnings up 36% year over year, total orders higher by 49%, and management raising 2026 guidance on the back of a sizeable commercial services and equipment backlog. The mix of a large services backlog, raised guidance, and continued supply chain and defense delivery pressure gives investors a clearer view of both the cash generation potential and the execution risks sitting inside General Electric today.
